about: Hand-checked identity facts. same_person: a printed name that is the person who owns that key (an OpenAustralia/TheyVoteForYou person id), where the names alone do not show it or the speech linker gave the print someone else's id. Read by scripts/roster_identity.py (the roster's pid), scripts/photo_identity.mjs (the portrait map check) and scripts/backfill_photos_oa.py. photo_aliases: reviewed portrait aliases only, never an instruction to assign a roster person id. wrong_face: a portrait file that shows somebody other than the person who owns its key; no name may map to it until the file is replaced and looked at. docs/PHOTOS.md, 'Identity check'.

a. koutsantonis.why: Tom Koutsantonis; Wikidata Q7816502 also names Anastasious Koutsantonis and dates SA House service from 1997, covering this SA House print in 2020-2024

a. piccolo.why: Tony Piccolo; Wikidata Q7823174 also names Antonio Piccolo and dates SA House service 2006-2026, covering this SA House print in 2020-2024

sophie panopoulos.why: Sophie Mirabella; Wikidata Q7563039 records Sophie Panopoulos and House service 2001-2013; the pinned electorate register independently gives Sophie Panopoulos as her alias for Indi, 2001-11-10 to 2013-09-07, covering the 2002-2006 print; existing portrait 10461 is owned by Sophie Mirabella

kathryn sullivan.why: Kathy Sullivan; Wikidata Q16106114 names Kathryn Jean Sullivan and dates House service 1984-2001; the pinned electorate register independently gives Kathryn Jean Martin Sullivan for Moncrieff, 1984-12-01 to 2001-10-08, covering the 1998-2001 print; never Jon Sullivan of Longman

alexander somlyay.why: Alex Somlyay (Fairfax 1990-2013); OpenAustralia lists him as Alexander Michael Somlyay; the linker gave 10725, John Alexander

antony windsor.why: Tony Windsor (New England); Antony is his given name

david tollner.why: Dave Tollner (Solomon 2001-2007); the only Tollner in the House

elizabeth coker.why: Libby Coker (Corangamite from 2019); the only Coker in the House

elizabeth webster.why: Anne Webster (Mallee from 2019), printed with her middle name; the only Webster in the House that year

katrina allen.why: Katie Allen (Higgins 2019-2022); Katrina is her given name

katter bob jnr.why: Bob Katter (Kennedy from 1993), printed 'Katter Bob Jnr' in 1998-99

kevin drum.why: Damian Drum (Murray, Nicholls 2016-2022), printed with his middle name

patrick conaghan.why: Pat Conaghan (Cowper from 2019); OpenAustralia lists him as Patrick John Conaghan; the linker gave 10903, Rex Patrick

patrick farmer.why: Pat Farmer (Macarthur 2001-2010); OpenAustralia lists him as Patrick Francis Farmer; the linker gave 10903, Rex Patrick

peter sidebottom.why: Sid Sidebottom (Braddon), printed with his first name Peter in 1998-99

robert baldwin.why: Bob Baldwin (Paterson); OpenAustralia lists him as Robert Charles Baldwin; the linker gave 10545, Stuart Robert

r.a. simms.why: Robert Andrew Simms, federal Greens senator 2015-2016 and SA Legislative Council member from 2021; the same person is printed with initials in SA Hansard

cory bernardi.why: Cory Bernardi, federal senator for South Australia (Senate speeches 2006-2019 in the record) and on the SA Legislative Council list for the 56th Parliament as at 13 Nov 2026 (One Nation, pmId 7377); the same exact full name and state, and the only Bernardi in the roster, so the Council seat links to this id and no second person is made
